verdict.rationale: The pack shows general automation: Apps Script automates Admin console tasks in a low-code environment, and provisioning changes sync automatically to third-party apps. Dynamic groups imply rule-based membership. None of these show user-defined event→action rules or event triggers. Missing for 10: documented event-based triggers (e.g. on edit, form submit, or email arrival), a rule builder for defining conditions and actions, end-user (not only admin) automation rules, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
